# Scenekind

> Scenekind is an AI-first creative production studio for product brands. It produces realistic AI commercials, product ads, motion design, and creator-style video assets with human creative direction and fast fixed-scope workflows.

Canonical site: https://www.scenekind.studio

Contact: https://www.scenekind.studio/contact

Email: hello@scenekindstudio.com

Scenekind serves DTC brands, ecommerce teams, SaaS companies, agencies, and brand teams that need commercial-quality video assets without a traditional production cycle. The studio replaces heavy production logistics such as crew, casting, location days, and creator sourcing while keeping strategy, concept, scripting, art direction, editing, sound, and grading human-directed.

Primary offer: Starter Sprint. Price: $295. Scope: three hooks on one product, delivered as three ready-to-run ads. Terms: nothing upfront; invoiced on delivery. Availability: six slots per month, one per brand.

Free entry offer: Creative Teardown. Scope: a written audit of a brand's current ad, product page, or launch context with three untested creative angles.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.scenekind.studio/): Scenekind's main offer, services, selected work, process, packages, FAQ, and free teardown CTA.
- [Contact](https://www.scenekind.studio/contact): Request a free Creative Teardown, start the $295 Starter Sprint, or scope a larger fixed-price project.
- [Rate Card Capture](https://www.scenekind.studio/#engagements): Email-gated PDF rate card for packages, monthly plans, a la carte rates, and terms.
- [Sitemap](https://www.scenekind.studio/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for public pages.

## Services

- [AI Commercials](https://www.scenekind.studio/services/ai-commercials): Directed cinematic AI commercials, launch films, hero spots, and platform cutdowns.
- [Product Ads](https://www.scenekind.studio/services/product-ads): Hook batches, product demos, performance creative, and paid social ad variations.
- [Motion Design](https://www.scenekind.studio/services/motion-design): Logo animation, kinetic type, UI motion, product motion, explainers, and launch teasers.
- [Creator-Style Video](https://www.scenekind.studio/services/creator-style-video): AI creator-style demos, avatar-led testimonials, native-feeling product explainers, and lifestyle spots.

## Selected Work

- [Le Mieux Bio Cell Cream](https://www.scenekind.studio/work/le-mieux-bio-cell-cream): Product ad built from frosted-glass staging, cream texture, molecular imagery, and a precise product reveal.
- [Fitness Wearable Launch](https://www.scenekind.studio/work/fitness-wearable-launch): AI commercial with floating product orbit, exploded-view assembly, and material macros.
- [AbsoluteJOI Night Oil](https://www.scenekind.studio/work/absolutejoi-night-oil): 19-second ritual film for a skincare night oil, with social, product, and tactile story beats.
- [GLASSFX DUO-HYDRAfx](https://www.scenekind.studio/work/glassfx-duo-hydrafx): 16-second product film built around a bi-phase formula: separate, shake, swirl, mist, settle.
- [Creator-Style Refill Demo](https://www.scenekind.studio/work/creator-style-refill-demo): Creator-led refill story with a product demo sequence and direct-to-camera close.
